external_collaboration.evidence_quote: The guest speaker, Prof. Dr Ivo Vankelecom (Head of the Membrane Technology Group) from Faculty of Biosciences Engineering at Catholic University of Leuven (KU Leuven), Belgium, delivered a talk on research and commercialization aspects of Membrane Technology and shared highlights of research on membrane technology from his group. The KU Leuven’s Membrane Technology Group is a specialized group with expertise and skills in the combination of knowledge in chemistry, materials science, engineering
